statements.statement: SELECT * FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO = ? FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO = ? ORDER BY ORLN
SELECT COUNT(*) AS LINECNT FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO = ?
SELECT * FROM {lib}.RCM WHERE CONO = ? AND CUST LIKE ? AND CUNAME LIKE ? ORDER BY CUST FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.HPH WHERE CONO = ? AND PONO LIKE ? AND VNAME LIKE ? ORDER BY PODATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM LIKE ? AND ITDSC LIKE ? ORDER BY ITEM, WH FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.LLH WHERE CONO = ? AND LHNO LIKE ? ORDER BY SHIPDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT YM, SUM(REVENUE) AS REVENUE, SUM(ORDERS) AS ORDERS, SUM(LINES) AS LINES FROM {lib}.SSH WHERE CONO = ? AND YM >= ? AND YM <= ? GROUP BY YM ORDER BY YM FETCH FIRST 24 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IIM WHERE ITEM LIKE ? AND ITDSC LIKE ? ORDER BY ITEM FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IIM WHERE ITEM = ? FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE ITEM = ? ORDER BY WH FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.HPO WHERE ITEM = ? ORDER BY ODATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ITEM = ? ORDER BY ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT CONO, ORNO, CUST, SHIP, HID, HSTAT, CHSTS1, CHSTS2, CHSTS3, CHSTS4, CHSTS5, ORDTE, REQDTE FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ? AND CUST LIKE ? AND ORNO LIKE ? AND ORDTE >= ? AND ORDTE <= ? ORDER BY ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ITEM, ITDSC, WH, UOM, IOHB, IISSU, IRCT, IADJU, (IOHB - IISSU + IRCT + IADJU) AS AVAILABLE, ISFQ AS SAFETY_STOCK FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ? AND (IOHB - IISSU + IRCT + IADJU) < ISFQ ORDER BY (IOHB - IISSU + IRCT + IADJU) ASC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ECH.ORNO) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(ECL.QTORD * ECL.PRICE) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM {lib}.ECH JOIN {lib}.ECL ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE ECH.CONO = ? GROUP BY ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, SUM(ECL.QTORD) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(ECL.QTORD * ECL.PRICE) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM {lib}.ECL LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON ECL.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE ECL.CONO = ? GROUP BY ECL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ITEM, WH, ITTYP, QTY, REFNO, TRNDTE, TRNTME, USERID, DBNAM, SERNO FROM {lib}.ITL WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM LIKE ? AND TRNDTE >= ? AND TRNDTE <= ? ORDER BY TRNDTE DESC, TRNTME DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT HPH.PONO, HPH.VNAME, HPH.PODATE, HPO.ITEM, HPO.ITDSC, HPO.QTYORD, HPO.QTYRCV, (HPO.QTYORD - HPO.QTYRCV) AS QTYOPEN, HPO.UPRICE, HPO.LREQDTE FROM {lib}.HPH JOIN {lib}.HPO ON HPH.CONO = HPO.CONO AND HPH.PONO = HPO.PONO WHERE HPH.CONO = ? AND HPH.PONO LIKE ? AND HPH.VNAME LIKE ? AND HPO.QTYRCV < HPO.QTYORD ORDER BY HPH.PODATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT LHNO, LHSTAT, CARRIER, DEST, SHIPDTE, ORDNOS, LINECT, WEIGHT FROM {lib}.LLH WHERE CONO = ? AND LHNO LIKE ? AND CARRIER LIKE ? ORDER BY SHIPDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT ITEM, ITDSC, WH, UOM, IOHB, ICOST, (IOHB * ICOST) AS STOCK_VALUE FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ? ORDER BY STOCK_VALUE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT VNAME, COUNT(DISTINCT PONO) AS PO_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN QTYRCV >= QTYORD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ON_TIME_COUNT, AVG(UPRICE) AS AVG_PRICE FROM {lib}.HPH JOIN {lib}.HPO ON HPH.CONO = HPO.CONO AND HPH.PONO = HPO.PONO WHERE HPH.CONO = ? GROUP BY VNAME ORDER BY PO_COUNT DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ?) AS TOTAL_ORDERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ? AND HID = 'CZ') AS CLOSED_ORDERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ?) AS TOTAL_ITEMS, (SELECT SUM(IOHB * ICOST) FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ?) AS INVENTORY_VALUE

SELECT ECH.CONO, ECH.ORNO, ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, ECH.CHSTS1, ECH.CHSTS2, ECH.CHSTS3, ECH.CHSTS4, ECH.CHSTS5, ECH.HID, ECL.ITEM, ECL.ITDSC, ECL.QTORD, ECL.QTYALC, ECL.QTSHP, ECL.QTINV, ESH.SHIPDTE, ESH.SHSTAT FROM {lib}.ECH JOIN {lib}.ECL ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST LEFT JOIN {lib}.ESH ON ECL.CONO = ESH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ESH.ORNO WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ECH.ORNO = ? ORDER BY ECL.ORLN
SELECT * FROM {lib}.BBH WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO LIKE ? ORDER BY INVDATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.SIH WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO LIKE ? ORDER BY INVDATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
